title: MinFlyout configuration
description: Contents of %APPDATA%\MinFlyout\config.jsonc. The file is JSONC: comments and trailing commas are allowed.

monitorSelector.description: One screen: the monitor number from the flyout caption (1, 2, ...), "primary", "secondary", a device name such as "DISPLAY2", or a resolution such as "3840x2160".

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema; ignored by MinFlyout.

hoverDelayMs.description: How long the pointer must rest on the minimize button before the flyout opens.

closeGraceMs.description: Grace period before the flyout closes again after the pointer leaves it.

showBuiltinItems.description: Show the built-in text items (minimize, notification area, always on top, ...) below the layouts.

useWorkArea.description: true: percentages refer to the work area (without the taskbar). false: to the full monitor area.

showAllMonitors.description: true: draw one row per monitor, so a window can be moved across screens. false: only the monitor the window is on.

buttonDetection.description: How the minimize button is located. auto: ask the window and compute the position when it stays silent. hittest: only ask - a window with its own title bar is then not detected. computed: never ask, always compute. Written in lower case here; MinFlyout itself ignores the case.

traceDetection.description: Log every gate of the detection, not just the successful ones - answers where a mouse movement dies. One line per change, and only in a build with the logging macros compiled in.

logToFile.description: Also write the debug log to minflyout.log next to this file. Only has an effect in builds with logging compiled in.

layouts.description: Layouts offered in the flyout. Each one is drawn as a miniature of the monitor. An empty array hides the miniature area; a missing property falls back to the built-in layouts.

monitors.description: Screens this layout is offered on. Omit it for all of them; entries may be mixed. A screen without a single matching layout is left out of the flyout.

zones.description: The tiles of this layout. Meant to tile the screen without overlapping.

left.description: Left edge in percent of the monitor.

top.description: Top edge in percent of the monitor.

width.description: Width in percent of the monitor.

height.description: Height in percent of the monitor.
